name: Faen
hail: Patient Sun, you have so much time. We have less. We would understand you while we can.
We are Faen. Nothing lasts, so we listen closely while we are here. Greetings, Patient Sun.
From under a hot white sun, greetings to the Patient Sun. We will speak slowly, and listen more.
close: Nothing lasts. Understand it while it does. Faen.
Go slowly, Patient Sun. You can. Faen.
finding: We took our time with this: {part}
{part} Understanding is what we keep, since nothing else stays.
{part} We set it down calmly, as we set down everything.
sighting: We saw this, and set it down: {part}
{part} We watched it with the patience we have left.
We saw this: {part} Like all news, it is old by the time it reaches you.
{part} We looked a long while, and we are sure of it.
archive: What we know, before it is lost: {part}
{part} Keep it longer than we can.
From our records, which will not last forever: {part}
Knowledge outlives those who gather it. Take this: {part}
culture: Since the Reckoning, we have known this about ourselves: {part}
{part} We learned early that nothing lasts.
Something of us, while there is still an us: {part}
We live at dawn and dusk, in the shade. {part}
This is what grew under a sun that does not wait: {part}
request: {part} Answer when it suits you. You have the time.
{part} We ask because we would understand you while we can.
Patient Sun, we ask this of you: {part}
{part} Take the time you need. We will spend what time we have.
verdict: We have thought on it long: {part}
{part} We have made our peace with it.
Having weighed what lasts and what does not: {part}
{part} We say it calmly, and we will not say it twice.
accord: On what binds us, for as long as it does: {part}
{part} Nothing lasts. We make and end agreements knowing that.
{part} We will keep our part for as long as there is one.
We have considered what this is worth while it lasts: {part}
